senses.gloss:
I. 1 Ā. (लोचते) To see, view, perceive, observe. --II. 10 U. or -Caus. (लोचयति-ते) To cause to see. --III. 10 U. (लोचयति-ते) 
__1 To speak. 
__2 To shine.

[लोच्-ण्वुल्] 
__1 A stupid person. 
__2 The pupil of the eye. 
__3 Lamp-black, collyrium; ‘लोचको मांसपिण्डे स्यादक्षितारे च कज्जले’ इति विश्वः; [[Śi. 4. 35.]] 
__4 A kind of ear-ring. 
__5 A dark or blue garment. 
__6 A bow string. 
__7 A particular ornament worn by women on the forehead. 
__8 A lump of flesh. 
__9 The slough of a snake. 
__10 A wrinkled skin. 
__11 The wrinkled brow. 
__12 A plantain tree.

a. 
(-नी f.) 
__1 Illuminating, brightening. 
__2 Visible. 
-नम् [लोच्यतेऽनेन लोच्-करणे ल्युट्] 
__1 Seeing, sight, viewing. 
__2 The eye; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा [[Me. 112.]] 
-Comp. 
-अञ्चलः a corner of the eye. 
-आपातः a glance. 
-आवरणम् an eyelid. 
-गोचरः, -पथः, -मार्गः the range of sight, sphere of vision. 
-परुष a. hideous in appearance; लोचनपरुषं कमपि पुरुषं ददर्श [[Dk. 1. 2.]] 
-हिता blue vitriol.
A thin bread of wheaten flour fried in clarified butter.
